question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: an MCP initialize request (jsonrpc 2.0, protocolVersion 2025-06-18, clientInfo public-agents-researcher 1.0), Content-Type application/json, Accept application/json and text/event-stream

decoded.challenge: www-authenticate: Bearer, with the single parameter resource_metadata=https://mcp.stripe.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource, and the value is NOT quoted (kept here rather than under headers, with a comma inserted after Bearer, because the schema's credential rule reads a long token-alphabet run after Bearer as a token; the transcript carries the header as received)
decoded.challenge-syntax: An auth-param value that contains a colon and slashes must be a quoted-string (RFC 7235 section 2.1); RFC 9728 section 5.1 writes resource_metadata="..." with quotes. Stripe's is bare, so a parser that follows the grammar does not extract it. The probe script's own quoted-string match did not, and reached the same document only because the RFC 9728 default path for this resource is the same URL
decoded.protected-resource-metadata: 200 at https://mcp.stripe.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource; resource https://mcp.stripe.com; authorization_servers: https://access.stripe.com/mcp; no scopes_supported and no bearer_methods_supported keys
decoded.authorization-server-metadata: 200 at https://access.stripe.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server/mcp; registration_endpoint present (/mcp/oauth2/register); scopes_supported: mcp (one scope); PKCE S256; grants authorization_code, refresh_token; token auth none only (public clients only); a revocation_endpoint
decoded.rest: not measured from here: the CONNECT to api.stripe.com was answered 502 proxy_upstream_refused by this container's egress proxy, so this run says nothing about what Stripe's REST API answers a keyless GET

finding: With no credentials, an MCP initialize POST to mcp.stripe.com answers 401 with a JSON body pointing at docs.stripe.com/mcp and a Bearer challenge whose one parameter, resource_metadata, carries its URL without quotes. That is outside the header grammar (an auth-param value with a colon in it must be a quoted-string, and RFC 9728 writes the parameter quoted), so a conforming parser does not see the URL; the probe script did not either, and found the metadata only because the RFC 9728 default path is the same URL. The metadata names access.stripe.com/mcp as the authorization server and lists no scopes. That server advertises dynamic registration, one scope (mcp), PKCE S256, two grants, and auth method none as the only token-endpoint method, so every client is a public client. The REST column is empty: this container's egress proxy refused the connection to api.stripe.com, which says nothing about Stripe. Same authorization server as the 2026-09-11 measurement in the entry's notes; the unquoted challenge is recorded here for the first time. Nothing here measures what either server does with a credential.
